description: Run the real 8-check AP2/Visa compliance grading engine (gradeCompliance — the same engine behind computeComplianceGrade and the commerce registry's verified_decisions block) over an inline file set. Each of the 8 validators (SCA/3DS2 readiness, AP2 mandate validity, tokenization posture, CE 3.0 readiness, dispute rail wiring, idempotency/receipt hygiene, budget negotiation, refund/cancel path) is a multi-signal check with weight, evidence trail, and remediation. Returns grade A-D, score, checks_passed/8, the full checks[] detail, detected commerce signals, and a sha256 reproducibility proof. Free, no auth, deterministic, no snapshot persisted. Hard caps: 25 files / 50KB per file / 1MB total. HONESTY: deterministic static source-signal analysis — a checklist starting point, NOT a certification, audit, PCI assessment, or card-network certification.
